IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Project Assistant post at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant post at IIT Roorkee is scheduled for 11 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Project Assistant position is Graduation with an MBA degree.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Assistant post at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Project Assistant role ranges from Rs. 26,000/- to Rs. 57,000/- per month, plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position involves an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age relaxation mentioned for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or relaxation details. Please refer to the official notification for more information.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview going to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the IIT Roorkee office. The specific address and timing will be detailed in the official notification.
